xml_content: <TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex013052025-11-2712-08-50" status="finalized" part="F">de la spong pa dang rtsom pa dang sgrub pa × dang ngo mtshar ba'i chen po gsum dang ldan pa'i <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3743">slob dpon zhi ba'i lha</rs>s gcig tu sgrub pa la zhugs pa na | bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gyi byin brlabs kyis | byang chub sems dpa'i bya ba phan yon dang bcas pa thugs la shar ba <lb n="1b3"/> rgyud la skyes nas bdag gzhan la phan pa'i byad par bsgrub pa'i phyir | shin tu rgyas pa'i mdo' sde'i don rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rgyu tshogs ma tshang pa med pa zhig | gzhung le'u bcus shu lo ka stong gi tshad du gyur pa | <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3727">byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa'i bstan bcos</rs> 'di zhal thon du mdzad do zhes bya ba ni gang bshad par bya ba'i chos yin no || de lta bu'i <lb n="1b4"/> gzhung 'di rnam par bshad na spyi don gnas kyis shes par bya ste | rtsom pa la 'jug pa klad kyi don dang | brtsam par bya ba skabs kyi don dang | mthar phyin pa 'jug gi don no ||</seg></TEI>
